paper_title: Extraterrestrial Axion Search with the Breakthrough Listen Galactic Center Survey
suggested_experiment_name: Breakthrough Listen GBT Galactic Center NS axion search
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on y-axis
notes: Foster et al. (2202.08274): search for axion DM conversion to radio photons in Galactic Center neutron star magnetospheres using Breakthrough Listen GBT C-band (4-8 GHz) data. Sets leading 95% CL constraints on g_agamma down to ~1e-11 GeV^-1 for m_a in 15-35 ueV. The full limit curve (Fig. 1, median over 100 NS population MC realizations) is not tabulated in the text; the two emitted points encode the paper's stated benchmark level ~1e-11 GeV^-1 over the stated mass range, so exact mass dependence (limit varies by O(few) across the band) is approximate. DM profile: NFW with scale radius 20 kpc normalized to local density 0.346 GeV/cm^3.
